transition: per symbol/mode; complete quality+signal false -> true; compute previous warmup signal; not reset on position occupancy

regime.lateral: ADX<20 and absolute EMA50 change over 3 hours <=0.003
regime.gap: 20<=ADX<22 enables neither mode; original 15m B ADX<22 remains

roi.timing: threshold selected at candle OPEN by elapsed holding minutes; no retrospective high; next-candle processing; original stop precedence and gap losses preserved
roi.a: minimum of original target 2.8% net and schedule; original trailing retained
roi.b: minimum of frozen SMA20, original 1.4% net and schedule; six-candle time stop retained

feeAwareGate.quotes: closed decision unit quote AND quantized next opening quote; entry base/quote fee, exit taker, common spread/slippage; initial target only; does not predict future win probability

squeeze.previousSqueeze: BB20 population std 2 strictly within EMA20 +/- 1.5 simple ATR20 at t-1
squeeze.trigger: closed t close > current BB20 upper and previous close <= previous upper; current green; current volume / previous 20 mean >=1.5
squeeze.exit: fixed stop/target; no new trailing, time stop or portfolio combination

selection: triage only, no automatic holdout/deploy/real approval. AB_FULL additionally requires both A_FULL/B_FULL eligible. No thresholds searched after replay; all negative cases retained.
unchanged: closed bars, next-open entry, pessimistic stop precedence
risk limits, daily halt, cooldowns, one shared position
